bullets.text: Three pony handlers at Besant Nagar Beach were arrested for robbing a couple at knifepoint, and the office should monitor tourist safety measures in Chennai.
The Greater Chennai Corporation repaired 1,531 of 13,227 potholes after rains, and the office should track road repair progress across the city.
Chennai faces AQI monitoring issues as monitors fail ahead of Diwali, and the office should watch air quality reporting systems.
The Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad will host 450 global delegates, and the office should observe technology and urbanization trends from the event.

stories.title: Three pony handlers arrested for robbing couple on Besant Nagar Beach
takeaways: Three pony handlers were arrested for robbing a young couple at knifepoint on Besant Nagar Beach.
Local law enforcement action follows the incident, highlighting security concerns in a key constituency area.

reports.title: Potholes develop on more roads in Chennai owing to rain

takeaways: Greater Chennai Corporation successfully repaired 1531 out of 13227 post rain potholes.
Crews continue fixing damaged bus routes and interior roads to restore proper vehicular movement.

stories.title: City’s AQI stagnation: no new monitors, existing monitors don’t relay data
takeaways: Chennai citizens lack reliable air quality data as state monitors fail and sensors go blank.
The 62 crore sensor network malfunction leaves residents blind during Diwali firecracker smoke.

stories.title: Telangana Summit Brings 450 Global Delegates to Hyderabad
takeaways: The Bharat Summit 2026 in Hyderabad attracts 450 global delegates from 100 countries.
Discussions will center on urbanisation, Future City initiatives, climate change, and artificial intelligence.
